suisjeamoureux.q1: On an ordinary day, how often do you think about this person?
suisjeamoureux.q1a: Rarely, only when something reminds me of them.
suisjeamoureux.q1b: Fairly often, without it taking over.
suisjeamoureux.q1c: Several times a day, and always with pleasure.
suisjeamoureux.q1d: Constantly. They are there in the background even when I am doing something else.
suisjeamoureux.q2: When you are with them, what happens to you?
suisjeamoureux.q2a: Nothing in particular, I am perfectly relaxed.
suisjeamoureux.q2b: I am glad to see them, the way I am with a good friend.
suisjeamoureux.q2c: My heart speeds up and I smile without deciding to.
suisjeamoureux.q2d: Everything gets sharper: the colours, the passing time, whatever I am feeling.
suisjeamoureux.q3: Their name appears on your phone. What is your first reaction?
suisjeamoureux.q3a: I reply when I have time, without thinking about it much.
suisjeamoureux.q3b: It makes me happy, like any nice message.
suisjeamoureux.q3c: I drop what I am doing to read it straight away.
suisjeamoureux.q3d: A little jolt in my chest before I have even opened the message.
suisjeamoureux.q4: They go away for a week without getting in touch. What do you feel?
suisjeamoureux.q4a: Nothing special, the week goes by like any other.
suisjeamoureux.q4b: I miss them a bit, like a close friend.
suisjeamoureux.q4c: A real absence, and I wait impatiently for them to come back.
suisjeamoureux.q4d: An emptiness that is hard to fill, as if part of my daily life had gone dark.
suisjeamoureux.q5: Something significant happens to you. Who do you want to tell?
suisjeamoureux.q5a: Several people, they are not the first who comes to mind.
suisjeamoureux.q5b: Them among others, with no particular priority.
suisjeamoureux.q5d: Them, and the event feels unfinished until I have told them about it.
suisjeamoureux.q6: Their flaws: do you see them?
suisjeamoureux.q6a: I do not know them well enough to have noticed any.
suisjeamoureux.q6b: I would rather not look at them, they would spoil the picture I have.
suisjeamoureux.q6c: I see them, some irritate me, but they change nothing about what I feel.
suisjeamoureux.q6d: I know them all, and I care about this person with those flaws, not in spite of them.
suisjeamoureux.q7: You learn they are very happy with someone else. Your reaction?
suisjeamoureux.q7a: Honestly, it would not affect me much.
suisjeamoureux.q7c: It would hurt for quite a while.
suisjeamoureux.q7d: It would devastate me, even though deep down I would still want them to be happy.
suisjeamoureux.q8: How much room does this person take up in your schedule?
suisjeamoureux.q8a: None, I see them when our paths cross.
suisjeamoureux.q8b: I am glad when we meet, but I do not arrange things around it.
suisjeamoureux.q8c: I often rearrange things so that we can see each other.
suisjeamoureux.q8d: I move important things for them, and I do it without hesitating.
suisjeamoureux.q9: What do you most want to share with them?
suisjeamoureux.q9a: Good times, nothing more than that.
suisjeamoureux.q9c: A lot, from the dull everyday to future plans.
suisjeamoureux.q9d: My life, including the parts I show almost nobody.
suisjeamoureux.q10: Do you ever picture a future with them?
suisjeamoureux.q10a: Never, the question does not come up.
suisjeamoureux.q10b: A few vague ideas, without really believing in them.
suisjeamoureux.q10c: Yes, often, and thinking about it feels good.
suisjeamoureux.q10d: Yes, and not only the good moments: I picture us getting through hard ones too.
suisjeamoureux.q11: What do the people around you say when you talk about them?
suisjeamoureux.q11a: Nothing in particular, I do not mention them often.
suisjeamoureux.q11b: That they sound nice, and that is all.
suisjeamoureux.q11c: That they hear me say their name a lot.
suisjeamoureux.q11d: That my face changes when I talk about them, and they noticed before I did.
suisjeamoureux.q12: How do you feel after spending time with them?
suisjeamoureux.q12a: The same as before, no better and no worse.
suisjeamoureux.q12b: In a good mood, like after any nice evening.
suisjeamoureux.q12c: Recharged, wanting it to happen again soon.
suisjeamoureux.q12d: Lighter and steadier at once, as if everything had got a little simpler.
suisjeamoureux.q13: A long silence settles between the two of you. How does it feel?
suisjeamoureux.q13a: Awkward, I start looking for something to say.
suisjeamoureux.q13b: It depends on the day and the mood.
suisjeamoureux.q13c: Comfortable, we do not need to fill the gaps.
suisjeamoureux.q13d: It is one of my favourite things about being with them.
suisjeamoureux.q14: What do you know about what they are going through right now?
suisjeamoureux.q14a: Not much, we do not talk about that sort of thing.
suisjeamoureux.q14b: The broad outline, what they tell everyone.
suisjeamoureux.q14c: What is on their mind at the moment, because I ask them.
suisjeamoureux.q14d: What frightens them and what they dream of, including what they rarely say out loud.
suisjeamoureux.q15: How far would you go to help them, expecting nothing back?
suisjeamoureux.q15a: As far as I would for anyone, no further.
suisjeamoureux.q15b: A little further than for most people.
suisjeamoureux.q15c: A long way, as long as it stays reasonable for me.
suisjeamoureux.q15d: Very far, and it would feel like a pleasure rather than a sacrifice.
suisjeamoureux.q16a: Yes, but only because there is not much at stake for me.
suisjeamoureux.q16b: I look after my image a little, nothing excessive.
suisjeamoureux.q16c: I catch myself playing a part to please them.
suisjeamoureux.q16d: I am myself, unflattering parts included, and it feels natural.
suisjeamoureux.q17: Do you ever compare them with other people you have been drawn to?
suisjeamoureux.q17a: They do not particularly stand out.
suisjeamoureux.q17b: They have something extra, though nothing striking.
suisjeamoureux.q17c: They eclipse the others by a long way right now.
suisjeamoureux.q17d: The comparison does not even occur to me, they are simply in a category of their own.
suisjeamoureux.q18: Do you remember your first real conversation with them?
suisjeamoureux.q18a: Not really, it happened without my paying attention.
suisjeamoureux.q18b: Vaguely, the setting more than the content.
suisjeamoureux.q18c: Yes, quite well, it was a good moment.
suisjeamoureux.q18d: In detail: the place, what they wore, what they said and what I felt.
suisjeamoureux.q19: You are told this relationship will stay purely a friendship, for good.
suisjeamoureux.q19a: That suits me perfectly, it already is one.
suisjeamoureux.q19b: A bit of a shame, but I would live with it easily.
suisjeamoureux.q19c: It would disappoint me a lot and I would need time.
suisjeamoureux.q19d: It would be a real loss to grieve, even though I would choose to keep them in my life.
suisjeamoureux.q20: If you had to tell them how you feel tomorrow, what would you feel?
suisjeamoureux.q20a: Nothing to tell, there are no feelings of that kind.
suisjeamoureux.q20b: Awkwardness, mainly because I am not sure what I feel.
suisjeamoureux.q20c: Enormous fear, but the urge to do it anyway.
suisjeamoureux.q20d: Relief at finally saying out loud something I already know.
suisjeamoureux.r1_d: Your answers describe someone you like, someone you have good times with, but who does not occupy the particular place a person you are in love with occupies. You think about them on and off, their absence leaves no gap, and the idea of them being happy with someone else does not turn your stomach. This is the portrait of a good friendship or a genuine affection, which is no consolation prize.
suisjeamoureux.r1_a: If you took this test, the question did come up somehow. It often comes from outside pressure, or from wanting something to begin. Let time do its work: romantic feelings announce themselves, they never need to be hunted for under a magnifying glass.
suisjeamoureux.r2_d: Something is taking shape without being settled yet. You think about them, you watch for their messages, their presence makes you happy, but your daily life still turns without them and you do not really know the person behind the image yet. This is the attraction phase, where you love the idea you have of someone as much as the person themselves.
suisjeamoureux.r2_a: The best way to know is to get to know them for real. Spend time together in ordinary situations, the ones that flatter nobody: a long wait, an annoyance, a day with nothing special in it. Attraction rarely survives boredom, love handles it perfectly well.
suisjeamoureux.r3_d: There is not much doubt left: this person holds a place others do not. You think about them every day, their absence weighs on you, you rearrange your time for them, and you see their flaws without those flaws denting what you feel. That last point is precisely what separates love from a simple crush. What usually remains is the uncomfortable part: not knowing whether it is mutual.
suisjeamoureux.r3_a: You now have the answer to your question, and another one takes its place: what to do with it? Waiting for the perfect moment to speak is the surest way never to find it. You do not have to make a solemn declaration: simply saying that this person matters a great deal to you is often enough to open the conversation.
suisjeamoureux.r4_d: Your answers go well beyond the thrill of the early days. You know this person deeply, fears included, you picture yourself with them through hard times and not only good ones, and you are yourself around them without having to polish anything. You want their happiness even when it does not run through you. This is the most solid and least spectacular form of love, the one that lasts.
suisjeamoureux.r4_a: Love of this intensity deserves to be said, and above all to be returned. Check one thing: does the effort run both ways? Loving very hard is never enough to make a relationship, and the most genuine attachment can wear itself out in a one way bond. If you have any doubt about what the other person gives back, that is the real subject to explore now.
